?

?Psalm 103:2 KJV
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

?Psalms 103v2 MSG
O my soul, bless God, don’t forget a single blessing!

Yes, it’s a new year and many will have lots of energy for new things. Traditionally, many will set new goals and even new resolutions forgetting what God did in the past year. They just “MOVE ON”

We’ve got to be wise

?
We will not just move on like nothing happened.
?We will make a big deal of everything God did for us..
?We will start this first Monday of the New Year with deliberate Thanksgiving giving Him ALL the glory..
?We will not be offering Thanksgiving in moderation to the one who made and still makes all things happen…the Almighty God.

Note?
?The way you show appreciation can trigger more from the same source.

Thank Him even if you entered the New Year with some “outstanding” dreams. He is very mindful of what you do.
?This year, God will overwhelm you with an avalanche of blessings, breakthroughs and results in Jesus name.

Never forget to acknowledge a single blessing and always show appreciation
